text:
maya: Heads-up — Snyk just flagged a CVE in tokenizers (<=0.13.2) that we pull into inference-runtime and python-sdk. Need quick triage.
jon: can you paste the report?
maya: https://snyk.io/vuln/SNYK-PYTHON-TOKENIZERS-2026-XXXX — parsing bug with native extension, severity: high.
anders: if the vuln is in input parsing we should treat as exploitable for certain endpoints. Which repos import tokenizers directly?
maya: inference-runtime, python-sdk, serving-runtime image (transitive via transformers). Dependabot opened PRs on a few repos: see CI failures.
dependabot: [automated] bump tokenizers 0.13.1 -> 0.13.3 in python-sdk (PR #432) :robot_face:
jon: I pulled the dependabot branch — CI is red on many repos because the new tokenizers triggers a starlette/fastapi transitive bump that breaks ASGI signature in some tests. Example log:
```
TypeError: __init__() got an unexpected keyword argument 'lifespan'
File "/workspace/.venv/lib/python3.11/site-packages/starlette/applications.py", line 56, in __init__
    super().__init__(routes=routes, middleware=middleware, lifespan=lifespan)
```
maya: OK — two tracks: security patch (bump tokenizers/transformers) + compatibility fixes to CI/SDK. Plan suggestion: 1) emergency lock update (poetry.lock) centrally for affected repos, 2) backport a pinned manylinux wheel for serving-runtime if binary ABI changes, 3) canary rollout, 4) customer advisory.
seb: We should validate whether fastapi/starlette versions introduce any request-parsing behavioral changes for our public APIs. I'll run the API contract tests.
security-bot: KMS audit — quick check: no customer KMS keys referenced by tokenizers or transformers. No evidence of key material exposure.
anders: I can handle rebuilding wheels and promoting to our internal package index. Need infra-runner access for cibuildwheel.
jon: I'll own python-sdk & inference-runtime PRs: update pyproject, regenerate poetry.lock, add test adapter for any async signature mismatch. ETA ~30–45m for the first PR.
maya: Assign owners: @jon = python-sdk, inference-runtime; @anders = serving-runtime wheel rebuild + package promotion; @seb = fastapi/starlette compat and API contract tests. Add temp mitigations: rate-limit and input size caps on parser endpoints until patch lands? :warning:
seb: I'll add a 10 req/sec rate-limit on /v1/parse and a 1MB payload cap in the ingress rule for the canary region.
jon: Opening PR now — includes lockfile update and a small shim for streaming init. CLI to repro locally: `poetry add tokenizers@^0.13.3 && poetry lock && pytest tests/unit`
maya: CI will be noisy — prefer merge via canary release policy: 2% traffic for 1 hour, then 10%, then 100% if no errors.
anders: Rebuilding manylinux wheels locally now. Logs:
```
Building wheel for tokenizers (PEP 517) ... error
Failed to find libstdc++ with required symbols on manylinux2014 image.
```
anders: Spun up ubuntu-latest runner with newer toolchain, build succeeded. Uploading to internal PyPI.
jon: PR #435 passed unit tests but integration test `test_chat_streaming_init` failed due to changed signature; pushed an adapter, rerunning.
ci-bot: [automated] All checks passed on PR #435 :white_check_mark:
maya: Great. After merge: 1) publish advisory to support/internal-docs with recommended pinned versions (tokenizers >=0.13.3, transformers >=4.30.1), 2) update Dedicated docs with image version and rollback instructions, 3) alert customers on Dedicated/Private about steps to rebuild if they vendor wheels.
anders: Starting image build for inference-runtime: tag inference-runtime:2026-03-11-hotfix. Will trigger Dedicated canary.
seb: API contract tests passed against canary build. No behavioral diff besides stricter lifespan arg handling in starlette — our wrappers needed an explicit lifespan kw.
maya: OK owners, please add links to PRs in the incident ticket INC-2026-45 and add a short postmortem stub.
jon: PRs merged and deployed to canary (2% traffic). Running smoke tests.
jon: smoke tests green. Increasing rollout to 10%. :rocket:
maya: Good work. After full rollout, we should backfill a short KB article: how to verify you aren't running vulnerable tokenizers, how to pin a safe version in poetry, example commands. I'll draft it. :memo:
anders: Also adding a CI gate to block merges that bump tokenizers without passing wheel build on our manylinux runner.
security-bot: Created audit log entry for this incident and attached Snyk report.
maya: Closing thread once the advisory and INC ticket have the follow-ups. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
